 Delivery Leader

 Technical Architect

 Team Builder

 Delivery ownership

A pure pre-sales or demo role you stay accountable through validation. Order-taking you translate needs into sound technical requirements. A CSV-only role although you need a good understanding of CSV/CSA .

Own the technical architecture for instrument and system connectivity scalable, compliant and robust . Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements , working closely with Software Application Specialists. Ensure delivery meets GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ and GAMP 5 expectations.

 Mentor and guide PAS team members; build a culture of excellence, innovation and continuous learning. Work in or lead Agile delivery teams ; align team execution with company objectives. Drive performance and operational efficiency across PAS engagements. Champion knowledge sharing, best practices and internal training within PAS.

 Translate AI agents and automation into practical RD and QC use cases. Show how standardized, contextualized data enables AI/ML.

 What Success Looks Like 
 DLX implementations are delivered on time, validated and audit-ready . Customers see you as a trusted technical advisor , not just a delivery resource. Solutions are scalable and supportable not one-off configurations. The PAS team grows more capable through your mentoring, playbooks and training. 
 
 Why Join Us

Enable breakthroughs that accelerate RD and improve data-driven decisions globally. A dynamic culture of continuous learning, creativity and growth . 
 
 What you bring 
 Must have first, then good to have Must have 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences lab informatics, with strong technical architecture skills designing how instruments, LIMS/ELN/LES/CDS and enterprise systems connect. Experience leading Proof-of-Value or pilot engagements. Please note: functional LIMS/ELN/LES implementation or business configuration experience on its own does not meet this bar . We need technical architecture, instrument-connectivity depth and customer consulting experience.
